messages:
Maria Chen: Quick heads-up — opening a TF + Helm PR to switch the payments k8s Service from ALB -> NLB so we can terminate TLS at the LB and reduce ALB rule churn. PR: https://git.redwood/example/pr/4321
Vik Patel: What's the main motivation for LB-side TLS termination instead of passthrough to pods?
Maria Chen: Perf (offload TLS), simpler cert rotation, and we avoid needing certs in every pod image. Also want more predictable connection draining.
Jon R: If you terminate at the LB, remember externalTrafficPolicy: Local if you need real client IPs, and update health check settings to hit the correct port/path.
Maria Chen: Plan is externalTrafficPolicy: Local and health check on 443 -> /healthz. We'll open node SG inbound 443.
Sophie L: Are you planning to use the standard annotations? e.g. `service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type: nlb` + SSL cert arn and ports. Also check target-type (ip vs instance).
Vik Patel: For Terraform/Helm interaction, prefer keeping overrides in the chart values in `helm_release` rather than modifying the rendered manifest in templates. Less brittle.
Maria Chen: Example values I'm adding:
```
service:
  type: LoadBalancer
  externalTrafficPolicy: Local
  annotations:
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type: "nlb"
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-ssl-cert: "arn:aws:acm:us-west-2:123456789012:certificate/abcd-ef01"
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-ssl-ports: "https"
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-target-type: "ip"
```
Vik Patel: Looks good. We'll need a separate infra PR to update the node SGs to allow 443 from the NLB and to attach the ACM cert if not already present. I'll make that after this merges.
infra-bot: CI: terraform plan failed in module.eks.services.payments — aws_lb_target_group missing health_check details (plan error).
Maria Chen: Thanks infra-bot — fixing health_check/named port in TF now, pushing a patch.
Jon R: Quick note: prefer target-type "ip" if using kube-proxy/iptables mode on our clusters; avoids instance port NAT headaches. Also check session affinity settings for checkout flows.
Sophie L: Also consider `service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-extra-security-groups` if you need the NLB in a shared SG topology.
Maria Chen: Addressed comments, added health_check path, switched to target-type ip, updated PR. @Vik PTAL when you have a moment :eyes:
Vik Patel: Will review in ~30m. If no blockers I'll merge and kick off rollout.
Maria Chen: Thanks — I'll do a focused smoke test on /checkout after merge and post results here. :rocket:
